title: Florida House, District 106
what_it_does: Represents District 106 (Part of Miami-Dade) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Fabian Basabe
candidates.occupation: State representative; businessman and former reality-television personality
candidates.background: Fabián Basabe, a Miami Beach businessman who appeared on the reality show Filthy Rich: Cattle Drive, was elected in 2022 by 240 votes and re-elected in 2024. He describes himself as fiscally conservative and socially liberal. In July 2026 a civil jury found him liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation claims brought by two former House employees and awarded $450,000; he denied wrongdoing.

candidates.name: Lucia Baez-Geller
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Miami-Dade County School Board member; former Miami Beach Senior High English teacher (2005-2020)
candidates.background: Lucia Báez-Geller, 42, taught English at Miami Beach Senior High for 15 years before winning a seat on the Miami-Dade County School Board in 2020. The daughter of Cuban and Colombian immigrants, she ran for Congress in 2024 and won the August 2026 Democratic primary for this seat.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

insurance.summary: She calls for insurer accountability, transparent rate reviews, timely claims payments, home-hardening grants and a stable insurer of last resort.
insurance.quote: Relief must reach policyholders—not become another blank check for the insurance industry.

property_tax.summary: She says eliminating or sharply reducing property taxes would threaten schools, public safety and local services without guaranteeing relief for renters.
property_tax.quote: Eliminating or sharply reducing property taxes would also threaten schools, public safety, infrastructure, and local services without guaranteeing meaningful relief for renters.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Lucia Baez-Geller

housing.summary: She supports fully funding the Sadowski trust funds, using public land for permanently affordable homes, and renter protections against junk fees and displacement.

abortion.summary: She supports abortion access before viability and says Florida's six-week ban takes away a personal medical decision before many women know they are pregnant.
